brief:
Israeli occupation forces injured five Palestinians on Friday in attacks scattered across the Gaza Strip, IMEMC News reported. The incidents marked the latest in a pattern of military operations continuing across the coastal enclave amid reported violations of ceasefire arrangements that have left the territory devastated.

Medical sources confirmed the five casualties but said two of the Palestinians were shot in areas outside those normally designated for such incidents. The specific locations and circumstances surrounding each of the injuries remained unclear, as operations persisted throughout the day across multiple zones in Gaza.
